regression.reproduction: Failed on the current root-synced snapshot: expected no pick for 1082858, found pick_index 1.
regression.cause: The dated research dossier names snapshot 2026-10-23T20:10:00Z and records Ground Zero vs Off Chops (1082858) as unresolved. A later snapshot (2026-10-25T05:12:25Z) resolved the fixture from current market evidence. The test applied the dossier's old state to the mutable current snapshot.
regression.fix: Only assert the historical unresolved state when the checked-in snapshot timestamp equals the dossier's published_snapshot.generated_at. On later snapshots, assert probability normalization, UTC observation timestamp, and a directional pick only when the probabilities are not exactly even.
